test.//inputs: Exclude *.e2e.ts so editing a resource-consuming suite never invalidates the default lane's cache — it never runs those files (its vitest `include` is `src/**/*.spec.ts`, see vite.config.ts). Mirrors the workspace targetDefaults.test inputs plus the negative pattern.

e2e.//: RESOURCE-CONSUMING lane. Runs ONLY the `*.e2e.ts` suites extracted out of the default `test` target (real live-dispatched Express servers bound to real ports, driven over real HTTP round-trips). Opt-in and deliberately NOT wired into any `test.dependsOn` nor into nx.json `targetDefaults`, so `nx affected -t test` / the pre-commit + pre-push hooks never reach it. `dependsOn: ["build"]` because it builds the package before exercising its real run() path. Its coverage dir is DISTINCT from the default lane's, and declares no dist-shaped output.
